propositions: Comment identity is persisted via a local_comment_key (HLC timestamp) to Jira comment ID map in binding_store, replacing body-equality deduplication
Returned add_comment {id} must be captured at both create_one and update_one enactment sites and written through record_comment_id with write-ahead durability
Comment sync is append-only: new comments sync bidirectionally once; edits and deletes are never pushed to Jira or applied from Jira
Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire (AdfCodec for Cloud, WikiTextCodec for DC) with fit-then-encode ordering before serialization
Inbound jira_comment_id and outbound map-key are directional authorities: outbound skips when key is mapped OR jira_comment_id present; inbound diff unchanged
The _diff_comments dedup-key path must migrate from _IdentityCodec to the real codec so normalized dedup keys match rendered wire format
